skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: I Am the Tides
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/I Am the Tides. An outfit Gladiia often wears. With the tides, she comes and goes freely between land and sea. The hunter is at ease, for the hunter is the tide.
skins.quote: She may prefer the classics, but even she is not immune to change. At her team's recommendation, she changes her wardrobe and hair once more. There is no trace of coldness in her step, and her every movement is graceful, as she always has been.

skins.name: Return
skins.content: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Return. Ægir Consul Gladiia's attire as she led her unit to return to the sea. Following sufficient exchange with the nations of dry land, the Ægir found themselves fully prepared to return to the home they'd left.
skins.usage: One of Gladiia's outfits for crucial moments.
skins.quote: 'My fellow Ægir, no longer does the sea lies behind us. We have no other choice.'
